summary: SMFG filed a 6-K announcing a planned transition to an intermediate holding company structure for its securities business in Japan, with SMBC Nikko becoming a sub-subsidiary via a share exchange around October 2026. Separately, SMFG, SMBC, and SMBC Nikko progressed discussions on forming a Japanese equities joint venture with Jefferies, previously announced September 2025. The share exchange involves no price per share or premium disclosed. SMFG’s board resolved the changes. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for completion of the joint venture and structural governance integration.
